description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5970016519397 SLEEVING,TEXTILE,EL: Line 0001 Qty 1085 UI FT Deliver To: By: 0042 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
